vo_natural_cumulonimbus_dark_base.evidence: At thumbnail scale, a broad nearly black base spans the middle horizon and remains visibly continuous with the tower above it.

vo_natural_cumulonimbus_tower.evidence: At thumbnail and native scales, deep cauliflower-textured turrets rise vertically from the same dark base through most of the frame.

vo_natural_cumulonimbus_anvil.evidence: At thumbnail and native scales, the connected upper cloud broadens into a pale horizontally spreading fibrous and striated canopy across the top of the frame.

vo_natural_cumulonimbus_precipitation.evidence: At native scale, a dense dark rain shaft descends from the central underside of the parent cloud to the basin, with a second rain curtain visible at right.

vo_natural_cumulonimbus_non_inference.evidence: Native pixels show the connected base, deep tower, striated upper outflow and ground-reaching rain shaft together; the judgment does not rely on lightning, smoke or dark color alone and makes no severity claim.
